set.body: Expose read-only optional confound companion lookup for a BOLD manifest path using the compiler's existing entity/pipeline/specificity matching and ambiguity refusal. Absence is an explicit successful None; invalid/non-BOLD targets are rejected. This must not enable nuisance regressors or alter no-nuisance catalog behavior. Consumer: plsneuro nuisance browsing before model selection. Verify matching, absence, unknown/non-BOLD targets and ambiguity on JVM and JS; adopt exact provider candidate separately in plsneuro.
set.title: Expose optional confound companion inspection without fitting configuration
